comment: Previous-green-main anchor for the skip-tracking dashboard (T4.3). CI fails if manifest.unauthorized_skips.length > baseline_unauthorized_skips. Update this baseline only when a new long-term skip is intentionally absorbed: (1) add the entry to SKIP_ALLOWLIST with issue + until, (2) increment baseline_unauthorized_skips here, (3) commit with a rationale comment. Never auto-increment from code. Note: raw test.skip() / test.fixme() calls bypass this gate today — capture of those is a planned follow-up (no release scheduled — v0.2 label retired). V2.G stage 3, items 10-11. As of 2026-09-16 the suite contains no raw test.skip()/test.fixme() calls: former raw skips became preflight failures (missing env var), BLOCKED failures (missing implementation / broken environment), or tracked softSkip() entries in SKIP_ALLOWLIST (genuine configuration preconditions), so extending capture to raw skips will fail nothing. V2.G stage 3, items 10-11.
